mode: Independent read-only static runner audit; no inference, tool programs, fixture validation or tests executed
verdict: conditional: address resource accounting/admission issues and establish fresh validation on final exact inputs before live freeze

findings.title: Freeze is not bound to the fixture-validation inputs
findings.evidence: freeze checks v.passed and v.rows.length, but not validation task IDs or fixture/source/visible hashes; independent review binds task.json and acceptance only. Inputs hashes are generated at freeze after validation.
findings.impact: A fixture change after validation can freeze stale baseline/reference pass/fail evidence. No such change was proven in this audit; fixture-validation.json was absent at inspection.
findings.minimalResolution: Validate final reviewed exact inputs immediately before freezing and preserve hash identity through freeze; preferably store and compare validation input hashes.

findings.title: Known-spend admission does not bound per-request overshoot or stop after unknown costs
findings.evidence: Admission checks knownUsd + .20 <= 3; an in-flight provider response can exceed .20; only completed-response cost is measured. Unknown totals are counted but do not prevent another admission. Budget checks abort after a tool-bearing response; final over-budget responses are ineligible but already spent.
findings.impact: The .20 value and $3 aggregate are eligibility/admission ceilings, not guaranteed maximum inference charges. Results retain overshoot/unknown flags correctly but later attempts may still start.
findings.minimalResolution: Before live execution, use conservative headroom and stop subsequent admissions on unknown cost or overshoot; disclose that no hard dollar cap can be guaranteed by post-response accounting alone. Keep all failed response receipts.

findings.title: Timeout and artifact ceilings are cooperative/admission checks
findings.source: src/benchmark-agent.mjs: timer; src/benchmark-governance.mjs: budgetEligible; scripts/benchmark-v1.mjs: artifact check
findings.evidence: 240-second timer asks session to abort. budgetEligible does not check latencyMs. Artifact bytes are checked before a run, not enforced during it. Deadline includes setup but abort before session assignment does not independently gate the later provider request.
findings.impact: These are not hard OS wall-time/disk bounds. A late response/finalization or a single growing run may cross nominal boundaries.
findings.minimalResolution: Describe limits honestly; include latency in eligibility if the 240-second ceiling is a strict scored eligibility condition. No OS sandbox redesign is necessary for this disclosed small calibration.

findings.title: Capability qualification helper is weaker than documented qualification rule
findings.evidence: Any semanticFailure yields capability-candidate-pending-failure-review, even without a success and without semanticFailureReviewed. TRACK_RULES asks for failure plus success or reviewed difficulty evidence.
findings.impact: Pending-review labels must not be promoted into qualified capability tasks without independent failure review and a successful baseline attempt or explicit additional reviewed evidence.
findings.minimalResolution: Keep label strictly provisional or align qualification predicate with the documented rule before promotion.

findings.title: Frozen coverage is broad but does not verify installed runtime/dependency bytes
findings.evidence: Freeze covers package/lock, runner, governance, agent, runtime, core workspace/navigation, governance tests, protocol, contract-review and entire fixture tree. Actual Node binary, installed dependency tree and credential content are not included.
findings.impact: Lockfile pinning is reproducibility evidence, not proof installed bytes match it. Credential contents should remain unfrozen/private.
findings.minimalResolution: Record Node/Pi versions and dependency resolution metadata; do not include secrets. Existing dependency read-only policy remains appropriate.

positiveFindings: Actor task object excludes acceptance/reference paths, sourceCommit, provenance and injected-change/repair metadata. Resource loader disables context files, skills, external extensions and prompt templates; actor prompt contains only public repository/task and edit allowlist.

Core reads and navigation use scopedPath/readText; traversal, absolute/colon paths, hidden paths, links and node_modules enumeration are excluded. Writes additionally require exact permitted existing production path. Evaluator data is outside actor workspace and symlinks are rejected by tree hashing.

Visible test execution has a minimized environment and Node read permissions restricted to actor workspace plus visible test. Hidden acceptance is evaluator-only and not returned to repair actor; actor cannot specify arbitrary test path or run shell tools.

Reference repair and acceptance are evaluator-controlled; actor workspace is copied from baseline. Post-run integrity hashes constrain immutable files. Acceptance, visible regression, integrity, model identity and budget eligibility are recorded separately.

Provider effort is checked before request and reported assistant model identity is checked afterward. Usage counts input/cache/output once; missing/nonfinite cost and error/aborted responses mark total unknown. API-equivalent costs are explicitly distinguished from subscription charges.

Exclusive active.lock prevents concurrent runners; completed result directories resume without repeats, partial directories fail closed and remain preserved. Stale locks require explicit investigation rather than silent deletion. Frozen input hashes are checked on calibrate/replay/report.

Protocol explicitly separates ex-ante engineering scope, empirical acceptance, observed effort and mechanism activation. All four inspected tasks are scopeTier 1. No tier2/3, long-horizon, superiority, untouched reserve or causal mechanism claim is justified by current calibration.
limitations: No OS sandbox/network deny layer. Node permissions constrain filesystem/process capabilities but are not a network isolation guarantee; malicious edited source executed by tests remains in the trusted local research threat model.
Static inspection is not end-to-end validation or proof against adversarial actor behavior. No attempt to execute attacks, graders or inference was made.
No manifest existed under .suffice/benchmark-v1 at inspection. fixture-validation.json was absent. Parent must complete final validation/freeze after reviews.

Core src/workspace.mjs, src/symbol-navigation.mjs and src/runtime.mjs had empty git diff versus this worktree HEAD. This audit wrote only research-printing scripts/reports. Original root frozen campaigns were not modified by this audit; their full before/after equality was not independently measured.
All hashes describe the read bytes for this receipt; concurrent parent edits after inspection require another hash comparison before applying this verdict.

Tool allowance counts parent codemode calls plus primitive calls according to extension events; this is acceptable if consistently applied to every arm and disclosed. Twelve-attempt maximum is the calibration schedule/result admission count; partial runs stop resumption rather than being silently excluded.

addenda.mode: read-only static patch review and saved validation receipt inspection; no fixture/test/inference execution

dispositions.R1: resolved for sequential final validation/freeze: full fixture-tree hash receipt compared at freeze; rerun after fifth fixture arrives
dispositions.R2: unknown-cost admission resolved by persistent totals gate plus immediate loop break; cost targets honestly described as post-response admission targets rather than hard billing caps; overshoot ineligible. No exact pre-request estimate required.
dispositions.R3: latency eligibility resolved: finite latencyMs <= timeoutMs is required and governance test includes 240001ms rejection. Timer/artifact checks remain cooperative/admission bounds, disclosed.
dispositions.R4: accepted limitation: capability-candidate-pending-failure-review remains provisional; cannot promote without documented independent review and qualifying evidence.
dispositions.R5: unchanged reproducibility limitation: installed dependency/runtime bytes not fully hashed; no secret capture recommended.

additionalNotes: validateContract now allows assertion mappings to visible named tests as well as hidden tests. Every hidden test must still be mapped; requirement coverage is across mapped visible+hidden names. The error text Requirement lacks a hidden check is now more restrictive than implementation and should not be quoted as a hidden-only coverage guarantee. This is acceptable for disclosed combined regression/acceptance mapping.
Original audit hashes are retained as historical snapshot; this addendum hashes the currently reviewed source.
A later Tier2 fixture requires a fresh independent contract review, whole-tree validation and freeze. No inference approval or untouched-heldout claim follows from this runner audit.
addenda.verdict: No remaining runner blocker identified for disclosed calibration on the reviewed exact code, once complete final fixture set passes validation and current contract-review hashes. Resource bounds retain disclosed cooperative/post-response semantics.

addenda.mode: Independent offline static reconciliation; no model calls, test/patch execution or benchmark mutations
addenda.verdict: Supplemental durable-event accounting is supported; integrity and campaign completion remain separate. Final transcript alone is not a complete failed-request cost ledger.
limitations: Original replay is retained; its unknown-cost mismatch on attempt004 is explained by the pruned failed assistant, not evidence that result total should become known.
Patch replay pass is verified from immutable saved replay receipts, not independently re-executed in this audit.
The supplemental script consumes replay receipts; its method field must not be read as saying audit-benchmark-receipts itself reruns graders.
A failed stream may have incurred unreported cost. Zero/absent reported usage is not proof of zero actual inference cost; unknown total remains null.
Durable events match events.live in these four completed run directories. Completeness of events for a process crash or unobserved upstream retry is not established.
Duplicate-turn rejection is useful but does not prove all provider requests received terminal assistant receipts.
